purpose: Canonical runtime state contract for one-active-deity battles: resources, stance, reactions, objectives, enemy intents, execution windows, terrain ticks, rewards, and telemetry.
Canonical runtime state contract for one-active-Deity battles: resources, stance, reactions, objectives, enemy intents, execution windows, terrain ticks, rewards, and telemetry.

stateShape.phase: PLAYER_PHASE | ENEMY_INTENT | ENEMY_PHASE | REACTION_WINDOW | TERRAIN_TICK | OBJECTIVE_EVALUATION | VICTORY | DEFEAT
stateShape.seed: deterministic integer seed for repeatable reducer tests
stateShape.titan: one active deity object with stats, hp, position, stance, cooldowns, status, mastery, and resources
stateShape.deity: one active deity object with stats, hp, position, stance, cooldowns, status, mastery, and resources

resources.solarCharge: Deity-specific 0-100 meter for Aten Ra starter slice

stateShape.enemies: array of enemy combatants with archetype, hp, position, intent, vulnerable flag, threatWeight, and status
stateShape.terrain: grid spaces with terrain type, hazard, illumination, cover, and objective tags
stateShape.objectives: array of objective state records with progress, requiredProgress, status, and reward hooks
stateShape.reactionWindow: null or prompt containing source enemy, type, cost, options, expiry, and consequence preview
stateShape.eventLog: append-only combat events used for QA and telemetry
stateShape.telemetry: counters for turns, damage, Momentum sources/spends, Divinity sources/spends, reactions, executions, objectives, hazards, and boss phase fails

reducers.name: createInitialSoloBattleState
reducers.responsibility: Build deterministic vertical-slice state from deity, enemy, terrain, and objective data.
Build deterministic vertical-slice state from Deity, enemy, terrain, and objective data.

reducers.name: applyDeityAction
reducers.responsibility: Resolve basic attacks, techniques, signatures, stance shifts, focus, execution, and Divine Ascension.

reducers.name: revealEnemyIntents
reducers.responsibility: Telegraph enemy plans before enemy resolution and expose counterplay.

reducers.name: resolveEnemyPhase
reducers.responsibility: Resolve AI intents against one active deity, opening reaction windows for major actions.

reducers.name: applyReaction
reducers.responsibility: Spend Momentum/Divinity if needed and resolve dodge, parry, counter, interrupt, mythic override, or failure.

reducers.name: applyTerrainTick
reducers.responsibility: Resolve hazards and terrain resource gains/losses after enemy phase.

reducers.name: evaluateObjectives
reducers.responsibility: Advance seals, anchors, exits, victory, defeat, reward hooks, and telemetry.

momentum.designIntent: Reward aggressive intelligent play instead of passive waiting.

divinity.designIntent: Gate mythic power behind visible performance beats.

solarCharge.spendOn: Law of Holding and Ascendant reinforcement windows

qualityGates: Only one player-controlled deity may be active in battle state.
Only one player-controlled Deity may be active in battle state.
Every major enemy action must have a telegraph or logged exception.
Reaction windows are turn-based prompts, never real-time inputs.
Momentum and Divinity must clamp between 0 and 100.
Objectives can end the fight without enemy wipe.
Reducers must be deterministic under the same seed and action script.
